# telnyx_external_connection_release (Data Source)

A request to release phone numbers from an external connection.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id.
- `release_id` (String) The release.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `error_message` (String) A message set if there is an error with the upload process.
- `status` (String) Represents the status of the release on Microsoft Teams.
- `telephone_numbers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telephone_numbers))
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `ticket_id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--telephone_numbers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `telephone_numbers`

Read-Only:

- `number_id` (String) Phone number ID from the Telnyx API.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number in E164 format.
